name: Sailor Fuku Senshi Felis
original_name: セーラー服戦士フェリス
source:
A UFO came and abducted three girls. Their classmate rode her grandfather fighter spaceship and hurried to rescue!

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
不明飞行物降临并绑架了三名女孩。他们的同学骑着她爷爷的战斗机飞船，赶去营救！
